turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Why does my son have a zero?
Before we go on, I'm recording this meeting.
Fine. So am I. Why is there a zero in the gradebook, Hale?
And if you so much as mention legal action, I'm filing a harassment complaint through the union.

I asked about a grade, Hale, and I'm writing down that your answer was a threat about a harassment complaint. Under procedure 4.2, I should have had a call before any mark was entered, and nobody called me. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
"Choose your words carefully." I'm writing that down too. I've chosen mine, and they're the same as they were when I walked in: tell me who decided on the zero, and what they based it on.
